## 1. Koide Formula + Mass Matrix

**Relevance to PF:** The Koide formula is a central anomaly in the Propagation Framework — a mass relation for charged leptons that PF frames may explain through coherence constraints on propagation eigenvalues. The family structure of 3 generations and geometry of mass matrices are direct PF concerns.

### Paper 1: Charged-Lepton Koide Geometry from a Green-Dressed Compact Family Cycle

- **arXiv ID:** [2605.10245v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10245)
- **Authors:** Kirill Shulga
- **Published:** 2026-05-11
- **Categories:** hep-ph
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2605.10245](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.10245)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> Koide's charged-lepton relation suggests that (√m_e, √m_μ, √m_τ) is the natural family vector. We construct an effective compact-cycle model in which this vector is sampled from one real amplitude Z(φ) on an internal circle, while the masses are quadratic overlaps, m_a ∝ |Z(2πa/3)|². The amplitude is built from the two lowest antiperiodic modes on the circle; their symmetric square is periodic and gives the minimal three-harmonic family space e^{iφ}, 1, e^{-iφ}. A reality condition together with the requirement that the amplitude comes from the square of one two-component spinor fixes the relative weights required by Koide's 45° geometry.

**PF Relevance: HIGH** — Compact-cycle model directly analogous to PF's internal propagation space. The three-harmonic family space {e^{iφ}, 1, e^{-iφ}} maps cleanly onto PF's N=3 generation structure. Quadratic overlaps from a single amplitude on a circle parallel PF's coherence-squared observable prescription.

### Paper 2: A Minimization Theorem for the Koide Ratio and its Standard Model Calibration

- **arXiv ID:** [2605.09651v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09651)
- **Authors:** K. Hübner
- **Published:** 2026-05-10
- **Categories:** hep-ph
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2605.09651](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.09651)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We prove that for any positive mass set with Koide ratio Q₀, the one-particle extension Q(m₁,…,m_N, x) has a unique global minimum Q_min = Q₀/(1+Q₀) at m* = [(∑ m_i)/(∑ √m_i)]². This exact kinematic result defines a unique extension benchmark. For the measured charged leptons it gives m*^ℓ = 1.25534(16) GeV and Q_{4,min}^{exp} = 0.3999978(43); in the ideal Koide limit Q_ℓ^K=2/3, the corresponding minimum is exactly 2/5.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH** — The exact Q₄_min = 2/5 in the ideal Koide limit suggests a deeper number-theoretic structure. The prediction of a fourth generation mass at ~1.255 GeV is a testable PF consequence if PF also predicts or constrains a fourth family. The effective-participant language N_eff ≡ 1/Q aligns with PF's effective dimensionality framework.

## 2. Fisher Information Metric + Particle Physics

**Relevance to PF:** Fisher information geometry underlies PF's metric structure on state-space. Papers connecting Fisher metrics to renormalization group flow and quantum information geometry may reveal geometric constraints relevant to PF's propagation manifold dynamics.

### Paper 1: Functional Renormalization Group as a Ricci Flow: An F-Entropy Perspective on Information Metric Dynamics

- **arXiv ID:** [2605.17215v4](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17215)
- **Authors:** Ki-Seok Kim
- **Published:** 2026-05-17
- **Categories:** hep-th
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2605.17215](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.17215)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We demonstrate an exact equivalence between the Functional Renormalization Group (FRG) and the Ricci flow modified by a potential-driven diffeomorphism. By reformulating the Polchinski exact RG equation into an infinite-dimensional Fokker-Planck framework, we show that the evolution of the Fisher information metric on the coupling constant space is driven by a thermodynamic free energy. We construct a field-theoretic F-entropy functional, defined as the continuous scale-dissipation rate of the free energy, which serves as an infinite-dimensional analogue of Perelman's F-entropy. The evolution of the field distribution functional constitutes a functional JKO-Wasserstein gradient flow that deforms the information metric.

**PF Relevance: HIGH** — Directly connects Fisher information metric dynamics to RG flow, which is precisely the mechanism PF uses for scale-dependent coherence evolution. The F-entropy as a dissipation rate maps to PF's propagation loss functional. JKO-Wasserstein gradient flow on the information metric is a candidate mathematical structure for PF's state-space dynamics.

### Paper 2: Path Integral Approach to Quantum Fisher Information

- **arXiv ID:** [2604.12763v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12763)
- **Authors:** Francis J. Headley, Mahdi RouhbakhshNabati, Henry Harper-Gardner, Daniel Braun, Henning Schomerus
- **Published:** 2026-04-14
- **Categories:** hep-th, quant-ph
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2604.12763](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2604.12763)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We present a real-time path-integral formulation of the quantum Fisher information for dynamical parameter estimation. For pure states undergoing unitary evolution, we show that the quantum Fisher information can be expressed as a connected symmetrized covariance of a time-integrated action deformation, equivalently as an integrated insertion of ∂_λ S in the propagator.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH** — Path-integral formulation of Fisher information provides a bridge between PF's propagation-path formalism and information geometry. The time-integrated action deformation connects directly to PF's propagation functional. If PF's coherence measure can be expressed as a quantum Fisher information, this formulation gives the computational framework.

### Paper 3: Quantum Magic Reveals CP Phases Invisible to Entanglement in Spin-0 Decays

- **arXiv ID:** [2605.19117v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19117)
- **Authors:** Nicolas Viaux, Ariel Norambuena, Pedro Orellana
- **Published:** 2026-05-18
- **Categories:** hep-ph, quant-ph
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2605.19117](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.19117)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> All standard scalar quantum-information measures — concurrence, negativity, entanglement entropy, the optimized CHSH bound, and quantum Fisher information — are CP-blind in ideal spin-0 → f f̄ decays because the two-qubit spin state is maximally entangled for every CP angle. We show that stabilizer magic, fixed in the physical Pauli frame of spin analysis, escapes this blind spot.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM** — Demonstrates limitations of Fisher information as a CP-phase probe, which is relevant for PF if PF claims Fisher metric completeness. Stabilizer magic as a complementary resource measure suggests PF may need to incorporate magic/magic monotones alongside Fisher information in its coherence taxonomy.

## 3. Coherence + Quantum Field Theory

**Relevance to PF:** Coherence is the core organizing principle of PF. Quantum coherence structures in field theory — modular theory, coherent vacuum decay, and stochastic reformulations — bear directly on PF's coherence-first ontology and propagation mechanics.

### Paper 1: Modular Self-Duality, Symmetrized Relative Entropy, and Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori Susceptibility in QFT

- **arXiv ID:** [2605.19106v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19106)
- **Authors:** Rupak Chatterjee
- **Published:** 2026-05-18
- **Categories:** hep-th, quant-ph, math-ph
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2605.19106](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2605.19106)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We develop an operator-algebraic framework for modular self-duality, symmetrized relative entropy, and Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori susceptibility of local states in quantum field theory. In finite dimensions, modular self-duality singles out fixed points at which a state coincides with its modularly reflected partner. At such points, the natural comparison functional is the symmetrized Umegaki relative entropy. It vanishes at coincidence, and its Hessian is governed by the Bogoliubov–Kubo–Mori quantum Fisher information along the reflected tangent direction. We then extend this fixed-point construction to the local type III von Neumann algebras that arise in QFT.

**PF Relevance: HIGH** — Modular self-duality fixed points in local QFT states directly parallel PF's coherence-stable propagation modes. BKM quantum Fisher information as the Hessian of relative entropy at fixed points provides a candidate metric for PF's state-space geometry near coherence maxima. The extension to type III von Neumann algebras is essential for relativistic QFT — PF must eventually address this regime.

- **arXiv ID:** [2602.03834v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03834)

- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2602.03834](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.03834)

**Abstract excerpt:**

We study this phenomenon using a two-dimensional interacting and coherently coupled Bose-Bose mixture, a platform that has already been employed experimentally to investigate false vacuum decay.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM** — Coherently coupled two-component Bose system as an analog simulator for false vacuum decay provides experimental access to coherence-driven vacuum transitions. If PF's propagation mechanism drives vacuum selection, this experimental platform offers a testbed for PF's coherence-selection predictions.

### Paper 3: Can Quantum Field Theory be Recovered from Time-Symmetric Stochastic Mechanics? Part I

- **arXiv ID:** [2603.20399v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20399)
- **Authors:** Simon Friederich, Mritunjay Tyagi
- **Published:** 2026-03-20
- **Categories:** quant-ph, hep-th
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2603.20399](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.20399)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We explore whether quantum field theory can be understood as the statistical mechanics of a time-reversal-invariant stochastic generalization of Hamiltonian dynamics. The motivation is to assign sharp values to all observables and thereby avoid the quantum measurement problem. We derive a generalization of the Liouville equation with natural constraints — reduction to classical Hamiltonian dynamics as ℏ → 0, Fokker-Planck form for the probability density evolution, local Hamiltonian flow.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH** — Time-symmetric stochastic foundations for QFT align with PF's time-symmetric propagation ontology. If QFT emerges as statistical mechanics of an underlying stochastic process, PF's propagation could be that underlying process. The generalized Liouville equation may connect to PF's propagation equation in the classical limit.

## 4. Center Symmetry + Quark Confinement

**Relevance to PF:** Center symmetry (Z_N for SU(N)) and confinement mechanisms connect to PF's N=3 framework, discrete symmetry structures, and the possibility that gauge group topology emerges from propagation constraints.

### Paper 1: Numerical Hints for Dyon Condensation at θ=2π via Wilson-'t Hooft Loops in SU(2) Yang-Mills

- **arXiv ID:** [2606.13428v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13428)
- **Authors:** Hiromasa Watanabe, Issaku Kanamori, Okuto Morikawa, Yuki Nagai, Yuya Tanizaki
- **Published:** 2026-06-11
- **Categories:** hep-lat, hep-th
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2606.13428](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.13428)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> Yang-Mills theories at θ and θ+2π are unitarily equivalent, but their 2π periodicity has a nontrivial realization. Recent developments in generalized global symmetries show that confinement vacua at θ=0 and 2π should belong to different symmetry-protected topological (SPT) states with the 1-form center symmetry. We measure the Wilson-'t Hooft loop operators at θ=2π for the SU(2) Wilson lattice gauge action. We obtain numerical evidence consistent with dyon condensation at θ=2π, rather than monopole condensation.

**PF Relevance: HIGH** — SPT-classified confinement vacua with 1-form center symmetry provide a topological classification that PF may predict from propagation constraints. If PF determines which SPT phase is realized at given θ, this paper provides the lattice observable (Wilson-'t Hooft loops) to test it. Dyon vs. monopole condensation connects to PF's charge quantization.

### Paper 2: SU(N_c) Confinement and Color N_c-ality

- **arXiv ID:** [2511.23413v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.23413)
- **Authors:** V. Tomas Mari Surkau, Urko Reinosa
- **Published:** 2025-11-28
- **Categories:** hep-ph, hep-th
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2511.23413](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.23413)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We have argued that the net quark number gained by a bath of quarks and gluons upon bringing an external static quark probe, while being equal to 1 in the high temperature deconfined phase, is equal to 0 or 3 in the confined phase, depending on the value of the quark chemical potential. This establishes a clear-cut connection between the confinement of a medium as probed by order parameters such as the Polyakov loop, and the ability of that same medium to screen the quark probe into states with the same net quark content as mesons or baryons. We extend these findings to the SU(N_c) color group.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM-HIGH** — The 0-or-3 net quark number in the confined phase is a direct manifestation of N_c=3 triality. If PF's N=3 is geometrically necessary, this screening pattern is a prediction. Extension to general N_c tests whether PF's triality is fundamental or emergent.

- **arXiv ID:** [2505.07467v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07467)
- **Authors:** Yui Hayashi, Yuya Tanizaki, Mithat Ünsal
- **Published:** 2025-05-12
- **Categories:** hep-th, hep-lat
- **PDF:** [arxiv.org/pdf/2505.07467](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2505.07467)

**Abstract excerpt:**
> We consider the semiclassical description of confinement for 4d SU(N) Yang-Mills theory on small ℝ²×T² with non-minimal 't Hooft twist p with gcd(N,p)=1. We construct the self-dual center vortex for non-minimal 't Hooft twists from the Kraan-van Baal-Lee-Lu-Yi (KvBLLY) monopoles by using the 3d Abelianized description of SU(N) gauge fields.

**PF Relevance: MEDIUM** — Center vortex confinement mechanism at large N connects discrete center symmetry to continuum confinement. If PF's propagation manifold has a built-in compactification, the center vortex structure may emerge as a topological consequence. The self-dual center vortex construction provides a concrete geometric object PF might predict.
